messages:
Juno (PM): Quick convo 00 planning note: proposing a product spec for model-catalog lifecycle that ties onboarding, pinning, and deprecation into a single workflow. Want to capture defaults + exceptions so Sales can quote pins without engineering ping-pong.

Diego (Eng): Sounds good. We need to be careful about automatic swaps. If the new variant changes tokenizer or max-seq, it can break customers. Suggest defining a "compatibility fingerprint" in catalog metadata.

Sam (Solutions): Field data: two ISVs care about embed schema backwards compat for retrieval. They want an opt-in migration testing window with sample vectors run against their index.

Priya (Sales): We need a canned set of pin SKUs: 30d grace (free), 90d extended (paid), 180d contractual (paid + legal). Sales needs language to put into renewals.

Omar (Legal): We can standardize contract language for paid pins. Need to call out rollback obligations and liability cap for deprecated model regressions.

Juno (PM): Proposal outline:
- Onboarding: every model entry must include benchmarks (latency, cost/500 tokens, embedding-drift sample) and a small eval set linked in metadata.
- Pinning: default pins = 30d auto-notice. Paid pin products: 90d and 180d. Pins are represented as catalog locks (immutable flag) and billed.
- Deprecation flow: staged notices (30d, 15d, 7d), canary route for 5% traffic, auto-swap only if compatibility fingerprint matches.

Diego (Eng): For the compatibility fingerprint include: arch, tokenizer-version, vocab-hash, quant-level, max-context, and decode-behavior-tag. We'll add an automated preflight: run 50-sample prompt bench, embedding-similarity check, and functional smoke tests before permit-swap.

Sam (Solutions): Migration tooling ask: UI to run a "dry-migrate" for a tenant (generate sample tokens/embeddings and diff) + a report template customers can sign off on. Also need a comm template: deprecation notice, migration guide, and FAQ.

Priya (Sales): For quoting: make pin SKUs public in the catalog page. Also want a checkbox in the renewal flow: request extended pin.

Omar (Legal): We need a standard addendum for paid pins. Also clarify support SLAs for migration assistance (hours included).

Juno (PM): Roadmap priorities (Q2):
1) Catalog metadata + compatibility fingerprint (ENG priority)
2) Pinning product + billing + renewal UI (PRODUCT+SALES)
3) Deprecation pipeline + canary routing + preflight checks (ENG+SRE)
4) Migration dry-run UI + customer report templates (SOLUTIONS)
5) Legal pin addendum + sales checklist (LEGAL+SALES)

Diego (Eng): Dependencies: kernel/runtime changes for quant variants (eng-runtime), bench harness for preflight (eng-ml), and canary routing hooks (eng-sre). Estimate: 6 sprints for minimal viable compat-fingerprint + auto-checks.

Sam (Solutions): Can we add an embedding-drift detector that flags customers whose vector similarity drops > X after swap? That could trigger automatic rollback.

Priya (Sales): If rollback protection is available, more customers will pay for 90/180d pins. Pitch angle = "migration insurance".

Omar (Legal): Rollback mechanics must be codified: timeframe, data retention, and who pays for rollback compute. We should add a clause.

deploy-bot: deploy started: dep-spec/v1 -> staging (by @Diego)

Juno (PM): Next actions: @Diego post the proposed fingerprint spec and preflight checklist in this thread by EOD Thursday. @Sam draft the comm templates + dry-run report prototype. @Priya, compile a list of customers asking for >90d pins. @Omar, draft a one-page pin addendum. We'll sync Friday backlog grooming to slot work into Q2.

Diego (Eng): Acknowledged. Will include sample JSON for metadata and an example preflight output.

Sam (Solutions): Will start on templates, I have two customer examples to adapt.

Priya (Sales): I'll pull the cohort and estimate ARR impact.

Omar (Legal): I'll draft the addendum and ping contracts for template language. :white_check_mark:
